questions.question:
Identify the segment of the sentence, which contains the grammatical error, If there is no error mark "No Error".

No sooner did the (A)/ comedian begin his act (B)/ when the audience roared with laughter. (C)/ No error (D)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 3 i.e. C**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e97c856a86e7f9a2254b6d21594beffe8b2a2afbb0c5bd00cd60b251c8f9881c.png] Explanation:

__
 
• Some conjunctions such as: ';** No sooner...than**', '**Hardly/scarcely...when**', are used in a pair. No sooner............ than is **coordinating conjunction** and both occur together. 
 
• For example :
 
 
• Hardly had I left the cinema hall than I saw the actor himself. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
• Hardly had I left the cinema hall when I saw the actor himself. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] * ​​
 
 
 
• Hence in the 3rd part of the sentence, 'than' will be used instead of 'when'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c04207879a25f2d797ba9b51141a9644344e291894960f97f7453f00b5b693.png] 

 
• Whenever 'did' is used as an auxiliary/helping verb, the main verb will be** in 1st form.**
 
• In case of these conjunctions, an inverted form of the verb will be used as illustrated in the examples above.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *No sooner did the comedian begin his act **than **the audience roared with laughter.*

questions.question: Three persons A, B, and C have different amounts of rupees with them. If C takes ₹11 from A, C will have equal amount as B has. B and C together have total ₹111. How many rupees does C have?
questions.solution:
Let the amount with C be X. Then, amount with C after taking ₹11 from A = X + 11

According to the given information, amount with B = X + 11.

Also, the amount with C before taking ₹11+ amount with B = 111.

⇒ X + X + 11 = 111

⇒ 2X = 100

⇒ X = 50

Hence, C has Rs 50.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

615 – 377 ÷ 29 × 15 + 308 = 502
questions.solution:
Given series:

615 – 377 ÷ 29 × 15 + 308

After interchanging + and –:

615 + 377 ÷ 29 × 15 – 308

= 615 + 13 × 15 – 308

= 615 + 195 – 308

= 502

Hence, the correct answer is 502.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, the length of BC is less than twice the length of AB by 2 cm. The length of AC exceeds the length of AB by 10 cm. The perimeter is 32 cm. The length (in cm) of the smallest side of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation: **

Let the length of AB = x cm

The length of BC = (2x - 2) cm, and the length of AC = (x + 10) cm

The perimeter of ΔABC = 32 cm.

⇒ x + 2x - 2 + x + 10 = 32

⇒ 4x + 8 = 32

⇒ 4x = 24

⇒ x = 6

The lengths of the sides of the triangle are:

AB = x cm = 6 cm

BC = (2x - 2) cm = 10 cm

AC = (x + 10) = 16 cm

**∴ The length of the smallest side of the triangle is 6 cm.**

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in a triangle ABC. It touches sides AB, BC, and AC at points P, Q, and R respectively. If BP = 5 cm, CQ = 7 cm and AR = 6 cm, then the perimeter (in cm) of the ΔABC is:

 BP = 5 cm, CQ = 7 cm and AR = 6cm

The lengths of tangents from a point on a circle are equal.

Thus, AP = AR = 6 cm

BQ = BP = 5 cm

CR = CQ = 7 cm

Now, AB = AP + PB = 6 + 5 = 11 cm

BC = BQ + QC = 5 + 7 = 12 cm

AC = AR + CR = 6 + 7 = 13 cm

The perimeter of ΔABC = AB + BC + AC

**∴ The perimeter of ΔABC = 11 + 12 + 13 = 36 cm **

questions.question: A man bought 2 articles for Rs. 4158 each. He sold one article at a 15% loss. Then at what percent profit the other article should be sold so that no profit/loss percentage is earned?
questions.solution:
**Calculation: **

The total cost price of both the articles = 2 × 4158 = Rs. 8316

The selling price of the article sold at 15% loss = 4158 × [(100 - 15)/100] = Rs. 3534.3

For no profit/loss, the other article must be sold for = 8316 - 3534.3 = Rs. 4781.7

Hence, the profit on the other article = 4781.7 - 4158 = Rs. 623.7

**∴ Profit percent on the other article = 623.7/4158 × 100 = 15%**

For a number to be divisible by 8, the last three digits of the number should be divisible by 8.

Putting y = 3, the last 3 digits become 832, which is divisible by 8.

For a number to be divisible by 11, the difference of the sum of the alternate numbers should be zero or multiple of 11.

⇒ The difference of (7 + 2 + x + 5 + 3) and (2 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2) should be zero or multiple of 11.

⇒ 17 + x - 17 = 0

⇒ x = 0

**∴ (5x + 5y) = 5(0) + 5(3) = 0 + 15 = 15**

questions.question: The chord of the contact of tangents drawn from a point on the circle x² + y² = a² to the circle x² + y² = b² touches the circle x² + y² = c² such that bm = aⁿcp, where m, n, p ϵ N and m, n, p, are prime to each other, then the value of m + n + p - 3 is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c331cc3d85df16ded591f39bc89920117054b5b8818b523bffb04fdc1fa754b.png] 

Let there is a point P(h, k) on the circle x2 + y2 = a2.

(h, k) will satisfy the equation x2 + y2 = a².

⇒ h² + k² = a² 

The equation of the chord of the contact of tangents drawn from the point P(h, k) to the circle x2 + y2 = b2 will be

hx + ky = b² 

Perpendicular distance of this tangent from the centre of the circle x2 + y2 = c2 will be equal to the radius of the circle.

⇒ |{-b² over sqrt{h²+k²}}| = c

⇒ |{-b² over a}| = c

⇒ b² = ac

Comparing it with bm = aⁿcp 

⇒ m = 2, n = p = 1

∴ m + n + p - 3 = 2 + 1 + 1 - 3 = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

and second biggest circle is x2 + y2 = b2.

and the smaller circle is x2 + y2 = c2.

Now, according to the figure

we can write OA = a, OB = b, OC = c

⇒ AC = a - c

Here, we can see that ∠ABO = 90° and also ∠ACB = ∠BCO = 90° 

Now, In ΔOBC 

BC² = b² - c² ----(1) 

In ΔABC

AB² = BC² + AC²

⇒ AB2 = b2 - c2 + (a - c)² ----(2) 

Now, In ΔABO

AB2 = OA² - OB²

⇒ AB2 = a² - b² ----(3)

From (2) and (3),

b2 - c2 + (a - c)2 = a2 - b2 

⇒ b2 - c2 + a2 + c2 - 2ac = a2 - b2

⇒ 2b² = 2ac

⇒ b2 = ac

Comparing it with bm = ancp 

⇒ m = 2, n = p = 1

**∴ m + n + p - 3 = 2 + 1 + 1 - 3 = 1**

• There are two sets of inflation indices for measuring price level changes in India - the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) and the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
 
• The WPI, where prices are quoted from wholesalers, is constructed by Office of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Commerce and Industries.
 
• The index used by the Reserve Bank of India till 2014 to make its monetary policy was WPI.
 
• Presently RBI uses CPI to measure Inflation.

questions.question: Which one of the following is an X-linked, recessive disorder caused by the deﬁciency of functional plasma clotting factor VIII (FVIII), which may be inherited or arise from spontaneous mutation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Haemophilia A.

__
 
• **Haemophilia A**__ is a frequently inherited genetic disorder that impairs the body's ability to form blood clots, a process required to stop bleeding.
 
• This results in people bleeding longer after an injury, easy bruising, and an increased risk of bleeding inside joints or the brain.
 
• Those with a mild case of the disease may have symptoms only after an accident or during surgery.
 
• Bleeding into a joint can result in permanent damage while bleeding in the brain can result in long term headaches, seizures or a decreased level of consciousness.

questions.question: ____________ was awarded the 'Kaisar-i-Hind' in 1915 by Lord Hardinge of Penshurst for his contribution to ambulance services in South Africa.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Mahatma Gandhi.

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**__ was awarded the Kaisar-e-Hind in 1915 by Lord Hardinge of Penshurst.
 
• He got it for his contribution to ambulance services in South Africa.
 
• Gandhi returned the medal in 1920 as part of the national campaign protesting the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
• The Kaisar-e-Hind Medal for Public Service in India was a medal awarded by the British monarch to civilians of any nationality who rendered distinguished service in the advancement of the interests of the British Raj.

questions.question: Which one of the following is deﬁned as "a private network that uses Internet technology and the public telecommunication system to securely share part of a business's information or operations with suppliers, vendors, partners, customers or other businesses"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Extranet.

__
 
• **Extranet**__ refers to a network within an organization, using the internet to connect to the outsiders in a controlled manner.
 
• It helps to connect businesses with their customers and suppliers and therefore allows working in a collaborative manner.
 
• It is implemented as a Virtual Private Networks (VPN) because it uses the internet to connect to corporate organization and there is always a threat to information security.
 
• VPN offers a secure network in public infrastructure.

questions.question: Who among the following was the Speaker of the 15th Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Meira Kumar.

__
 
• **Meira Kumar**__ was the speaker of the 15th Lok Sabha.
 
• She was the first woman to become the speaker of Lok Sabha.
 
• The book “Indian Parliamentary Diplomacy- Speaker’s Perspective” is written by Meira Kumar.
 
• Sumitra Mahajan was the second woman after Meira Kumar and she headed the 16th Lok Sabha.
 
• The current speaker is Om Birla of the Bharatiya Janata Party, who is presiding over the 17th Lok Sabha.
